reconciliation.note: The own prior artifact had already randomized-continuum-covered Gaussian KL through 1.25 and reported outward anchor growth. This run therefore did not repeat the stale 1.1->1.3 dense-shell action; it followed the artifact's stronger next action and sought an analytic high-information handoff.

mechanism.name: terminal exact Gaussian sentinel sharing existing sufficient statistics
mechanism.candidate_interval: first materialized gap for the H=48/T0=700,g=16 scale

scored_blocks.gap: 16 observations containing the unknown discrete changepoint offset x=0..16; excluded from the sentinel score
scored_blocks.B: 48 observations after the gap, all from Q for any x=0..16

mechanism.offset_property: Because the entire 16-sample alignment gap is excluded, the sentinel's A and B blocks are homogeneous and its power bound is independent of x=0..16.
tests: two-sided exact F test on S_B^2/S_A^2
two-sided pooled Student t test on mean_B-mean_A
mechanism.null_validity: Under a no-change Gaussian null, F~F_{47,683} and pooled t~t_{730}. Split the sentinel per-start alpha equally across the two tests; Bonferroni gives per-start false-alarm <= alpha_start. With start weights pi_k summing <=1, assigning alpha*scale_weight*eta*pi_k to each start gives global sentinel PFA <= alpha*scale_weight*eta by union bound.
mechanism.state_cost: No additional individualized detector state is required if A/B count, mean and SSE are already retained by the candidate; only terminal test computation is added.

power_bound.alternative_class: all Gaussian Q=N(mu,r), either mean sign, with D_KL(Q||N(0,1))>=1
power_bound.parameter_reduction: For fixed r, F-test miss is independent of mu and the t-test miss bound decreases with |mu|. Hence the worst allowed |mu| is mu_*(r)=sqrt(max(0,3+log r-r)), reducing the unbounded 2D KL>=1 region to one dimension r>0.
power_bound.F_miss: M_F(r)=F_F(f_hi/r)-F_F(f_lo/r), with F_F the CDF of F_{47,683}. Its derivative is [q(f_lo/r)-q(f_hi/r)]/r where q(z)=z f_F(z). For the F density q is increasing on z<1 and decreasing on z>1, so M_F increases for r<=f_lo and decreases for r>=f_hi.
power_bound.t_miss_bound: Let D=mean_B-mean_A~N(mu,1/684+r/48), independent of W=chi2_683+r*chi2_47. For any s>0, Hsu/Laurent-Massart gives P(W>EW+2 sqrt((683+47 r^2)s)+2 max(1,r)s)<=exp(-s). On the complement, pooled-t nonrejection implies |D|<=tcrit*sqrt(1/684+1/48)*sqrt(W_bound/730). Thus t-miss is bounded by exp(-s) plus an exact normal interval probability; optimize s.

partition.certificate: F-miss is monotone increasing up to the boundary point because r<f_lo; therefore miss <= 8.444367447513201e-07.

Use one fixed t-bound envelope with mu>=0.993921466987104, r<=1 and s=15.682154459243396. Coupled weighted-chi-square monotonicity plus normal interval monotonicity yields miss <=0.017364840629926687.

Use one fixed t-bound envelope with mu>=1.065470293457705, r<=2.94482113329493 and s=5.647411635583814. The normal interval derivative in sigma is positive throughout the bounding rectangle; its sufficient monotonicity condition has minimum margin 21.90135611686597. Miss <=0.07116965699646308.
Since r>f_hi, F-miss is monotone decreasing; miss <=M_F(2.94482113329493)=0.07116965699646312.

power_bound.numeric_scope: The inequalities and monotonic reductions are analytic, but the reported roots/quantiles/constants were evaluated in ordinary float64/scipy arithmetic, not directed-rounding interval arithmetic.

comparison_to_radial_randomized_cover.prior_own_shell: The earlier own r76 artifact covered only 1<=KL<=1.25 with 853 anchors and 14501 direct-joint CP bounds and still required floating-point geometric cover.
comparison_to_radial_randomized_cover.sentinel_result: For the first start weight pi1, the terminal t/F sentinel gives a non-Monte-Carlo power bound over the entire unbounded Gaussian KL>=1 class while consuming 3% of the scale PFA budget and adding no individualized state.
comparison_to_radial_randomized_cover.important_limit: This does not yet replace later-start power certification: pi_k shrinks with k under PFA spending, so the same KL=1 bound weakens for later starts. It also does not prove anything for non-Gaussian/heavy-tailed alternatives.

checked_public_sources.use: Primary-source confirmation that simultaneous equality of two normal populations admits an exact finite-sample likelihood-ratio treatment.

checked_public_sources.use: Public reproducible implementation confirms the sufficient-statistic likelihood-ratio form and exact Dirichlet null integration.

checked_public_sources.use: Provides the Gaussian quadratic-form upper tail used for W=chi2_683+r chi2_47.

scope_limits: First-start/first-gap power constant uses pi1. Later start weights require a start-index-aware floor or a different PFA capital-recycling construction.
The sentinel is a proposed companion channel; repository detector behavior has not been changed in this clean exploration run.
The bound assumes Gaussian step changes and the clean A/gap/B segmentation described above.
No heavy-tail, non-Gaussian, gradual-drift or within-B changepoint claim.
Numeric constants are not machine interval verified.
exact_next_action: Derive the start-index-aware curve I_floor(k,eta) for the terminal sentinel under the actual pi_k sequence, and test whether a small fixed eta can cover enough rolling starts to eliminate most randomized radial certificates. In parallel look for a PFA-valid capital-recycling/e-process construction that avoids shrinking fixed-time alpha across late starts without adding individualized state. If that fails, use the sentinel only as a finite early-start analytic handoff and retain the original future-tail e-process for late starts. Then interval-verify the first-start constants.
